Only 5 US partners listed: ASU, Pace, Simmons, UConn, University of Oregon. Simmons, UConn and Oregon list only Degree admission, Transfer admission, English preparation (excluded) and, for UConn, Special programs (pre-professional 4-year bachelor's tracks, not a pathway/foundation) and Simmons dual engineering degree (full degree); none recorded.
ASU 'Degree admission' and 'Transfer admission' (and Pace equivalents) are direct/transfer admission routes, not pathways; excluded. ASU Degree preparation page does not mention a master's pathway.
